subject: Contract addendum: EU data certification + APAC standby & capacity sprint
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma.t@medtechinc.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@medtechinc.com
Date: 2026-08-31T09:06:00+01:00
Subject: Renewal / EU residency + APAC standby — next steps

Hi Jonas / Ben,

As we move toward the contract renewal (term ends 2026-10-15), our security and ops teams have one blocking ask: can Redwood commit to an EU-primary data residency SLA for production traffic and an APAC warm-standby path for failover? We need explicit language in the SOW/addendum for audit and for our upcoming SOC review.

High level asks:
- EU-primary tenancy for production (data at rest in EU region).
- APAC warm-standby that can be promoted within a 60-minute RTO for DR drills.
- A short ops-runbook and checklist for our M+N capacity surge (anticipated +25% peak).

Can you propose contract language and a timeline for the capacity sprint and a joint DR drill before renewal? Also, any evidence you can share (SOC2 artifact list, encryption KMS mapping) would help our Security team.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Torres
Head of Platform Ops | MedTech Inc.

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned and can deliver an addendum that covers EU-primary tenancy + APAC warm-standby with defined RTO/RPO and a capacity uplift path.

What I'll do:
1) Share a draft "Geo Addendum" with specific SLA language for EU residency and APAC failover (attaching draft).
2) Include an ops checklist for the capacity sprint and suggested timelines for a joint DR drill.
3) Provide an evidence packet summary (SOC2 checklist, encryption, and KMS controls) for your security review.

Proposal for dates (flexible):
- Capacity planning kickoff: 2026-09-08
- Capacity sprint / uplift window: 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-24
- Joint DR drill: 2026-09-28 (dry run) / 2026-10-05 (formal)

I'll loop Legal on the addendum redlines. Ben / Lauren / Neha — can you confirm the technical feasibility for the +25% burst in the EU pool and the 60-minute RTO target? Also note MedTech wants audit artifacts — Neha, can you prepare the artifact index.

Jonas

Emma / team — quick technical note from infra:
- EU-primary tenancy: we can pin MedTech production workloads to our eu-central cluster with dedicated vNIC and encryption keys scoped to the tenancy.
- APAC warm-standby: we can seed a mirrored fleet in apac-east with cold-warm KV priming; promotion within 60 minutes is achievable with the runbook below, assuming coordination on DNS TTL reduction and session handoff.
- Capacity uplift (+25%): we'll reserve a dedicated buffer pool for the sprint; estimate for reserved GPU hours is attached in the ops sheet.

Action items for MedTech:
- Confirm whether DNS-based failover is acceptable or you prefer routed proxy failover.
- Approve sprint sizing so we can reserve capacity.

I'll be available for the kickoff on 9/8.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Technical Solutions | Redwood Inference

Jonas — legal review (high level) of the addendum draft:
- Need explicit sentence for data-at-rest residency in clause 2.1 and penalties for failure to comply (we typically ask for a service credit tied to breach windows).

- Please include an appendix listing the SOC2 artifacts you will provide and the expected delivery timeline.

If you can update the draft by EOD 2026-09-04 we'll try to include the addendum in our procurement packet for the weekly approval board on 2026-09-09.
